dedupe_keys.name: colorado river simulation system crss and mid term modeling system crmms

description: The US Bureau of Reclamation produced two basin-wide models of the Colorado River system, the Colorado River Mid-term Modeling System (CRMMS) and the Colorado River Simulation System (CRSS), both built in the commercial RiverWare software and kept up by its Upper and Lower Colorado Basin Regions. They simulate the operation of the major reservoirs month by month, giving storage, reservoir elevations and dam releases. CRMMS produces the 24-Month Study and the 2-year and 5-year probabilistic projections from unregulated inflow forecasts, while CRSS projects years to decades ahead from historical natural flows for policy and scenario studies. Coverage is the Colorado River Basin. The projections are free to read online, and model questions go to Reclamation by e-mail. Caveats: the models need RiverWare, the page does not offer the model files for download, and all projections carry uncertainty that Reclamation discusses separately. Simulation uses: reservoir operations, shortage tiers and drought planning for water supply and irrigation. Related records: Reclamation's RISE open data (data-usbr-rise-reclamation-open-data).
